message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Bump version

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      bump-type:
        description: 'Bump type'
        required: true
        default: 'patch'
        type: choice
        options:
        - major
        - minor
        - patch

concurrency:
  group: bump-version-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Bump version
        id: bump
        uses: callowayproject/bump-my-version@master
        # env:
          # GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # BUMPVERSION_TAG: "true"
          # BUMPVERSION_COMMIT: "true"  #TODO: This is a temporary fix
        with:
          args: ${{ inputs.bump-type }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check
        if: steps.bump.outputs.bumped == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Version was bumped from ${{ steps.bump.outputs.previous-version }} to ${{ steps.bump.outputs.current-version }}!"
",
  "rationale": "This workflow is a single-job workflow_dispatch version bump: it has no matrix, no schedule, no tests, and no dependency-install step, so fail-fast, schedule suppression, test selection/prioritization, and pip-cache patterns do not apply, and there is no measured job history to derive a history-based timeout. The evidence-supported fit is P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE: repeated dispatches on the same branch are runs of the same workflow/branch and a newer dispatch supersedes an older one, so canceling in-progress superseded runs avoids duplicate work. It is safe here because the executed job only computes a version (commit/tag are currently disabled) and performs no deployment, and grouping by github.ref keeps distinct branches isolated. The change adds only a top-level concurrency key, preserves the single job and its check step, and adds no actions, secrets, permissions, or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}

name: Bump version

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      bump-type:
        description: 'Bump type'
        required: true
        default: 'patch'
        type: choice
        options:
        - major
        - minor
        - patch

concurrency:
  group: bump-version-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Bump version
        id: bump
        uses: callowayproject/bump-my-version@master

          args: ${{ inputs.bump-type }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check
        if: steps.bump.outputs.bumped == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Version was bumped from ${{ steps.bump.outputs.previous-version }} to ${{ steps.bump.outputs.current-version }}!"
